thread:
alex: paging: prod alerts -> spike in 5xx from control-plane auth-proxy, seeing gateway 502/504s. Customers reporting failed calls to Redwood API. Notified on-call.
incbot: [ALERT] controlplane.auth-proxy error-rate > 8% for 5m across us-east-1. Pager: alex. Severity: P1. See /incidents/2543216789.
alex: quick datapoints: errors started ~2543216740, ramped at 2543216760. Autoscaling didn't help; gateway is returning 502s upstream.
jamie: grabbing traces and upstream logs now. Any config rollouts in last hour?
ryan: no config pushes from runtime team in last 2 hours. Saw a flurry of token-refresh requests to auth orglookup endpoint. Might be heartbeat/refresh storm.
maya: customer impact: internal telemetry shows ~12% of requests from paying customers failing for text gen endpoints in us-east-1. We should notify ops and classify incidents.
jamie: logs: tail from auth-proxy: 
``` 
2026-03-15T14:12:34Z ERROR upstream | conn reset by peer - 502
2026-03-15T14:12:35Z WARN  kv-cache miss spike for tenant 1234
2026-03-15T14:12:36Z ERROR rate limit window exceeded for heartbeat-check
```
alex: hypothesis: auth service heartbeat/registry causing thundering requests -> proxy overloaded -> gateway 502s. Could be orglookup cache TTL eviction at the same time.
ryan: confirming: orglookup cache TTL was recently set low in a config tweak (candidate change 2678) rolled yesterday. TTL=30s for high-consistency, which can cause stampede when many token refreshes hit.
ryan: mitigation options: 1) increase cache TTL to 5m, 2) enable orglookup local in-proxy cache (fast path), 3) add temporary 429-based circuit-breaker on auth orglookup to protect downstream, 4) route traffic to dedicated fallback region.
jamie: immediate action: patch proxy to serve stale cache for 60s and enable a short-term circuit-breaker. I can push a hotfix to the proxy in 30s. Any objections?
alex: go for it. I'll open a canary route for critical customers to fallback to us-west-2 where error rates are normal. Maya, please prep customer comms for top 10 paying customers.
maya: on it. Draft: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors in us-east-1 affecting API calls; mitigation in progress; we'll share updates every 15m."
incbot: incident channel created: #incident-2543216789. Paging policy escalated to SRE lead and runtime.
ryan: hotfix diff (snippet): 
```
// proxy cache middleware
if (cache.miss && cache.staleExists) {
  return serve(stale, 200, { 'x-cache-stale': 'true' })
}
// circuit breaker: if upstream 5xx rate > 5% return 429 fast
```
jamie: deploying hotfix to auth-proxy pool A (no-downtime rolling deploy). Rolling now. Monitoring.
alex: rolling route: mark pool A as canary, shift 10% of traffic, watch 5xx%.
jamie: pool A deploy completed, 10% canary in place. 5xx dropped from 12% -> 7% on canary. Good signal.
ryan: increasing cache TTL on config service to 300s via emergency override. Pushing now.
jamie: config change applied, proxy now serving stale cache path + circuit breaker enabled. Observed overall 5xx falling to 3% in last 90s.
maya: customer impact update: top 10 customers affected reduced to 2 with transient 5xxs. Sending proactive email to those two.
alex: good. Next steps: keep canary for 10m, then roll hotfix cluster-wide if stable. Prepare postmortem and RCA owner.
ryan: RCA owner acknowledged: ryan (runtime). I'll collect traces, config change timeline, and orglookup metrics.
jamie: oncall handoff at 15:00 UTC -> jamie will remain primary for next 30m then hand to ryan.
alex: confirm paging handoff to SRE lead in 30m if any regression.
maya: note for postmortem: include customer impact table, timeline, and decision log for TTL tradeoff.
incbot: [UPDATE] severity remains P1. Next update scheduled in 15m or on major status change.
ryan: quick note: creating a temporary routing rule to prefer us-west-2 for affected tenants until config TTL permanently tuned.
jamie: monitoring metrics: latency stable, error-rate trending down. Will keep channel open.
alex: thanks team. If 5xx < 1% for 15m, we'll begin de-escalation and draft incident summary.
maya: drafting summary now, will attach list of customers notified.
ryan: saving logs, traces, and diffs for postmortem.
jamie: handing off active ops to ryan at 15:00 UTC. I'll add details in #oncall-handoffs.
alex: closing the loop: great triage. Keep the channel updated if anything pops back up.
ryan: acknowledged.
incbot: [RESOLVE] provisional mitigation in place. Continue monitoring.
